messages:
zoe_cs: Vireo Labs sent their vendor security checklist during onboarding. They want DPA answers + SOC2 scoping confirmation + a short KMS/key-provenance excerpt. Deadline = Fri EOD.
upload-bot: uploaded vireo_vendor_checklist.pdf (shared)
nina_pm: FYI renewal review in two weeks; CS please prioritize.
zoe_cs: ask: they specifically want rotation cadence, audit log retention location, and confirmation whether BYOK is supported for Hosted.
matt_security: short answer draft: 'Hosted: keys managed by Redwood with HSM-backed storage and tenant separation. Dedicated/Private: BYOK supported with integration guidance.'
dan_eng: add rotation/audit lines: 'Keys rotated annually or after incident; rotation and access events logged to centralized audit store and retained per retention policy.'
matt_security: I'll prepare a one-paragraph attestation and a redacted provenance template. Keep IDs masked.
zoe_cs: also need a one-page redacted dataflow PNG. Dan, can you make a simple diagram with boxes and no real IDs?
dan_eng: yes, can get a redacted PNG in an hour.
zoe_cs: perfect. Once attachments ready I'll respond to Vireo and track feedback in the onboarding checklist.
matt_security: attestation draft posted below, feel free to tweak:
"Redwood Inference encrypts customer data at rest using industry-standard KMS with HSM-backed protection. For Hosted deployments keys are managed by Redwood; for Dedicated/Private customers may supply BYOK. Keys are rotated annually or on-demand and all key operations are logged to our centralized audit system. Redacted key provenance examples can be provided upon request."
upload-bot: uploaded vireo_attestation.txt, vireo_key_provenance_redacted.txt, vireo_dataflow_onepager.png
zoe_cs: thanks team :raised_hands: I'll send answers now and update when Vireo confirms whether this is sufficient.
